svg.title: Lattice Join
svg.desc: The lattice engine resolves profiles and facets into an effective policy, then project overrides apply.

g.text: DefaultPolicy sets govet, common-utils, SLSA 1, and independent ReviewMode.
native-gpu-systems sets memory bounds, SLSA level 3, and linters.
A security facet enforces linear history, signed commits, and security linters.
Complexity caps take the lowest positive bound. Reviewer count and SLSA level take the maximum. Booleans keep true. Lists are deduplicated unions. strict_ban wins for
error_unwraps. ReviewMode keeps the stricter mode (independent) when both sides are known, but passes through an unknown/invalid mode unchanged so validation catches it
ApplyOverrides keeps monotonic strictness for branch protection and supply chain, except for ReviewMode which can be explicitly relaxed.
The unified policy is consumed by standardsctl audits, adoption plans, devcontainers, and workstation environments.
